newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Gov proposes $1.17 bln capital outlay plan.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Gov proposes $1.17 bln capital outlay plan.

text.p: California Gov. Pete Wilson proposed Thursday $1.17 billion in expenditures for the state's capital outlay program.

Wilson said funding for the program, part of his $66.6 billion spending plan for fiscal year 1997-1998, would come from general obligation bonds, lease revenue bonds, federal funds, general funds and various special funds.
The following were among the largest capital outlay proposals outlined by Wilson:
* $485.7 million existing general obligation bond expenditures for higher education
* $334.5 million proposed lease revenue bond expenditures, general fund and federal funds for the California Department of Corrections
* $53 million federal funds, proposed lease revenue bond expenditures and general funds for the Department of the Youth Authority
* $32.5 million general fund, special funds and reimbursements for the Department of Parks and Recreation
